title: Fix crash when cancelling an order
prompt:
Cancelling an order crashes in production. Traceback:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "app.py", line 41, in cancel_handler
    svc.cancel(order_id)
  File "shoplib/orders.py", line 64, in cancel
    self.inventory.add_stock(line.sku, line.quantity)
AttributeError: 'OrderLine' object has no attribute 'quantity'

Please fix it. Cancelling an order should put its units back in stock and mark the order as cancelled; cancelling the same order a second time should still be an error.
